tests.description: Seven authenticated PostgREST cases for shared event description, PATCH length, and complete icon contracts.

fixture_needs.name: authToken
fixture_needs.purpose: Cached worker identity token from the configured Supabase auth provider.

fixture_needs.name: coupleEvents
fixture_needs.purpose: Worker-scoped userId/anchor and checked pair-only cleanup before/after each test.

fixture_needs.name: validationContract
fixture_needs.purpose: Extract tagged JSON from supabase/tests/database/21_events_validation_contract.sql using existing strict parser.

fixture_needs.name: boundaryText
fixture_needs.purpose: Unique ASCII string padded to exactly the requested length.

fixture_needs.name: validationEvent
fixture_needs.signature: (userId: string, anchor: Date, overrides?: Partial<EventInsert>) => EventInsert
fixture_needs.purpose: Valid complete event payload with fresh client-generated id and label, future calendar date derived from anchor, explicit description/icon defaults; omit timestamps so defaults are server-generated.

fixture_needs.name: EventRowSchema
fixture_needs.purpose: Full wire-row Zod schema; passed through apiRequest.validateSchema. Do not coerce or transform timestamps, since GET snapshot equality must preserve raw wire values.

provider_contract.response: Array of full snake_case rows; error envelope code/details/hint/message
provider_contract.constraints: label <= tagged labelMaxLength, description <= tagged descriptionMaxLength, complete icon in tagged icons

summary: Generated one API spec in JSON only: 7 cases (3 P1, 4 P2). Authenticated positive controls distinguish validation failures from broken auth/write paths. Independent GETs prove refused POST inserts no row and refused PATCH preserves the last valid full row. No retries, browser fixtures, hard waits, local fixture creation, or test execution introduced. Production, ledger and sprint files remain untouched. Pact artifacts excluded by parent relevance gate; broker unavailable and provider source used.
